name: Horrors in the Highland

angles.text: As a druid, you can sense the natural balance shifting through roots and waterways. You may recognize how suddenly ancient corruption threatens freshwater life.
As a dwarf, you know that digging in the highlands has disturbed more than ancient relics. Rethiel urges the excavators to stop before worse evils awaken.
As an Alliance explorer, you know that prospectors at mountain excavation sites risk disturbing ancient forces buried beneath the earth.

aliases: who gives horrors in the highland
faq.answer: Rethiel the Greenwarden, an ancient protector of the Wetlands, offers the work after sensing corruption seeping through a nearby mountain gully.
faq.q: Who offers the quest Horrors in the Highland?

faq.answer: Highland Horrors dwell at the excavation sites on higher ground above the lowlands, near the mountain gully where corruption seeps.
faq.q: Where can Highland Horrors be found?

faq.answer: Highland freshwater creatures have never known the sea's protective salt, leaving them defenseless against the spreading corruption.
faq.q: Why are the highland creatures so susceptible to corruption?

faq.answer: A Highland Horror's root core is the heart of the corrupted creature. Rethiel needs it to examine the unnatural power spreading through the waterways and learn the nature of the corruption.
faq.q: What is the root core of a Highland Horror?

faq.answer: When you return the root core, Rethiel discovers that an ancient energy has begun to stir from deep within the earth, likely disturbed by digging at the excavation sites.
faq.q: What does Rethiel discover when you return the root core?

faq.answer: Rethiel warns the excavators to stop digging at once for their own safety. Their work risks releasing dangerous ancient forces.
faq.q: Why does Rethiel want the excavators to stop digging?

sections.body: Rethiel the Greenwarden senses the land changing deep in the Wetlands. Through a mountain gully, foul taint reaches the highlands and infects their freshwater creatures. Lowland life has been shaped by brackish water, but these creatures have never known the sea's protective salt. Rethiel fears they cannot withstand the spreading evil. He asks you to climb to the excavation sites, slay a Highland Horror, and bring back its root core.
sections.title: Taint in the Gully

sections.body: When you bring Rethiel the Highland Horror's root core, he confirms his fears: an ancient energy has begun to stir. The highland creatures suffer from no ordinary sickness. Recent digging has brought on the affliction. Rethiel warns the excavators to stop at once. Their curiosity could unleash something far worse upon the Wetlands and put everyone in the region at risk.
sections.title: An Ancient Stirring

summary: Rethiel the Greenwarden senses corruption flowing through a mountain gully into the Wetlands' freshwater. He sends you to the highland excavation sites for a Highland Horror's root core, then warns that digging stirs an ancient energy and endangers the whole region.
attribution: In-game quest text: Horrors in the Highland
